steps.say: Start with a round centre.
Loop gentle petals around it.
A stem reaches down to the ground.
Add two leaves. What colour will yours be?
A tall shape with a pointy nose.
A round window to see the stars.
Two fins help our rocket look ready.
A zigzag flame. This rocket lives in our imagination.
A little oval makes the body.
A big looping wing on the left.
Another looping wing on the right.
Two antennae curl toward the sky.
One more antenna. Add your own patterns!
A square is the start of our home.
A triangle roof keeps it cosy.
Draw a door to welcome a friend.
A little window for the sunshine.
A soft oval for a swimming friend.
A triangle tail waves hello.
Give your fish a curious eye.
A fin helps it turn.
Add a bubble.
Two lines make a sturdy trunk.
Round shapes make a leafy crown.
A little branch reaches out.
Another branch on the other side.
A gentle curve makes a shell.
Curl around toward the middle.
A long body slides along.
A tall feeler looks around.
A second feeler waves hello.
Join four corners for a diamond.
Draw a line across the middle.
Draw a line from top to bottom.
Let a ribbon wiggle below.

start.text: {pet} finds a tiny paper star beside the window. “I wonder where you belong?” A silver trail leads into an imaginary night sky.

trail.text: The trail ends at a cloud. The star is quiet. {pet} sits beside it. “We can work this out together.”

moon.text: The moon glows softly. “Some stars belong in the sky. Some belong in a home full of stories.” {pet} looks at the little paper star.

choices.label: Make a home on our wall
Ask the star what it likes

map.text: You draw a map full of dots. The little star points to a window. It looks just like yours!

song.text: Your quiet song sounds like home. The star twinkles toward the window. “Perhaps home is where we feel welcome,” says {pet}.

ask.text: The star gives a tiny rustle. It wants to be near your pictures. {pet} smiles. “We remembered to listen.”

choices.label: Find a place on our wall

home.text: You hang the star near your art. It was a pretend journey, but the kindness was real. “Welcome home,” whispers {pet}.

start.text: On an imaginary beach, {pet} spots a beautiful shell. A tiny crab is resting beside it. “Shall we look closer?”

watch.text: You notice the crab slowly moving toward the shell. Maybe this is its home. {pet} waits with you.

hello.text: “Hello, little neighbour,” says {pet}. The crab pauses. You leave plenty of room so it can choose where to go.

choices.label: Make a picture of the beach

space.text: The crab settles beside the shell. You sit a little further away and listen to the pretend waves. Sometimes helping means giving space.

draw.text: You make a shell shape in the sand. “We can keep a picture and leave the beach as we found it,” says {pet}.

end.text: The shell stays on the beach. You take a lovely memory home. {pet} remembers how carefully you watched and listened.

stories.title: The seed that took its time
stories.subtitle: Nature · Patience · 4 minutes

start.text: {pet} finds a little seed in our story garden. “What could this become?” You tuck it gently into soil.

water.text: The soil is gently damp. Now our seed needs sunlight and time. Nothing changes straight away, and that is okay.

choices.label: Make a picture while we wait
Tell the seed a gentle story

sun.text: A warm patch of light reaches the pot. You add a little water. “Growing takes its own time,” says {pet}.

choices.label: Make a picture while we wait
Tell the seed a gentle story

wait.text: In our story, several days pass. You draw what you imagine the plant might look like. Then one morning, a tiny green shoot appears.

story.text: You tell a story about a giant garden. Several story-days pass. The plant grows slowly, with soil, light, water and time.

end.text: The shoot is small and wonderful. {pet} smiles. “Small beginnings count.” You keep a memory of the seed that grew in its own time.
